Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning economic development and trade through collaborative development of the state trade web portal.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to economic development and trade throughcollaborative development of the state trade web portal; and adding anew section to chapter 43.330 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.330 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Subject to available funds, the department must: (a) Develop, maintain, and update a centralized state trade webportal; (b) Collaborate with state and federal agencies, trade experts, andrepresentatives of the business community to acquire relevant tradecontent to include in the centralized state trade web portal; and (c) Collaborate with public and private organizations, tradeexperts, and representatives of the business community to promote thecentralized state trade web portal. (2) The department may: (a) Derive revenue from the centralized state trade web portal.Sources of revenue may include, but need not be limited to, p. 1 SSB 5737advertisements placed on the centralized state trade web portal bythird parties; and (b) Commercialize and license the centralized state trade webportal technology. (3) Any organization that receives state funding to develop traderelated content must collaborate with the department to develop andprovide relevant trade content for inclusion in the centralized statetrade web portal. The department may also create a direct link fromthe centralized state trade web portal to the trade web portaldeveloped independently by the organization receiving state funding.
